model: OR4 pro smoke release device (RM4 optical smoke switch), BACnet IP
equipment_type: Duct smoke detector / smoke release device
applies_to: Wildeboer OR4 pro duct smoke release devices with the RM4 optical smoke switch and FS7 flow sensor, BACnet version.
summary: The OR4 pro is a duct smoke release device built around the RM4 optical smoke switch. Its BACnet interface is small: airflow and contamination level as Analog Inputs, operating hours of the OR4 and RM4 as Analog Values, and alarm, contamination trend, fault and airflow flags as Binary Inputs. Nothing is writable.
notes: Objects come from the EDE file (bacnet_EDE_OR4_02.csv) in Wildeboer's interface ZIP; all are marked not settable.
Object names and state texts are German, kept as in the EDE (ASCII spellings such as Stroemung).
The ZIP also holds a German PICS (or4pro_bacnet_pics_de_01-00) titled BACnet IP.
Instance numbers follow the EDE object-instance column (1-9 running). The PICS in the same ZIP numbers the same objects per type instead (AI 1-2, AV 1-2, BI 1-5); check with a scan.

source.title: BACnet Interface description OR4 pro (EDE files + PICS, ZIP)

integration.summary: Read-only device: map the smoke alarm, fault and contamination flags and the airflow flag, plus the contamination level for service planning.
setup: Device object OR4-02 Device, instance 2000 in the EDE file.
gotchas: The EDE and the PICS number the objects differently (running 1-9 vs per type); confirm instances with a device scan before mapping.
